steps.tx: Partial failure of Mullerian fusion giving a heart shaped uterus with indented fundus is a **bicornuate uterus**. Two horns share one cervix in the commonest anatomical form. It associates with preterm birth and malpresentation more than infertility. Careful history taking and examination help place this finding in the right clinical context before treatment is planned.
steps.say: Bicornuate uterus is heart shaped from partial fusion failure with one cervix.

steps.tx: Failure of midline septum resorption leaving a divided cavity with normal fundus is a **septate uterus**. It carries the worst reproductive record of the anomalies, especially recurrent miscarriage. Hysteroscopic resection is simple, quick and effective. Correlating this finding with imaging and laboratory results prevents both delayed treatment and unnecessary intervention in most patients.
steps.say: Septate uterus divides the cavity with a normal fundus and causes recurrent miscarriage.

steps.tx: External contour separates septate from bicornuate, so imaging must show the fundus, termed **contour assessment**. Three dimensional ultrasound or MRI provides it non invasively. Ultrasound of the cavity alone misclassifies dangerously. Early recognition matters because timely treatment gives clearly better outcomes than waiting for complications to develop first.
steps.say: Contour assessment by 3D ultrasound separates septate from bicornuate uteri safely.

steps.tx: Complete non fusion with two uteri, two cervices and often two vaginas is **uterus didelphys**. Each side may menstruate and conceive independently of the other. An obstructed side presents painfully at puberty with haematocolpos. Students should connect this fact with the presenting symptoms, since examination questions usually test that clinical link directly.
steps.say: Uterus didelphys doubles uterus and cervix from complete non fusion.

steps.tx: One duct developing alone gives a single horned uterus, the **unicornuate uterus** covered next in this series. A rudimentary horn may hide a functioning cavity that ruptures if pregnant. Renal agenesis on the failed side is common. Documenting this finding clearly in the notes guides the next clinician and supports safe, well planned further management.
steps.say: Unicornuate uterus develops from one duct with renal agenesis on the failed side.

steps.tx: Pregnancy in a non communicating rudimentary horn ruptures catastrophically and is prevented by **horn excision** when found. Diagnosis is often first made only at rupture. Laparoscopic removal of the horn is definitive treatment. When this picture is seen in practice, urgent senior review is wise whenever there is any doubt about severity.
steps.say: Rudimentary horn pregnancy ruptures catastrophically, so excision prevents it.

steps.tx: Strassman unification joining bicornuate horns is now rare because outcomes without it are usually good, a **surgery restraint** lesson. Surgery follows only repeated adverse outcomes attributed clearly to the anatomy. Septate resection remains the exception with clear benefit. Understanding this mechanism explains the symptoms, the investigation findings and the logic behind each step of treatment given.
steps.say: Surgery restraint leaves bicornuate uteri alone unless repeated adverse outcomes prove causation.

steps.tx: Cervical incompetence accompanies several anomalies and cerclage decisions individualise by history, termed **anomaly cerclage judgement**. Routine prophylactic cerclage for anatomy alone is not supported by evidence. Ultrasound surveillance of cervical length substitutes. This distinction changes management, so it should be settled early rather than after empirical treatment has already begun.
steps.say: Anomaly cerclage judgement individualises by history rather than anatomy alone.

steps.tx: Every Mullerian anomaly earns a renal tract scan because of shared embryology, the **renal screening rule**. Finding agenesis or an ectopic kidney changes surgical planning and counselling. It is a one time ultrasound with lifelong value. Careful history taking and examination help place this finding in the right clinical context before treatment is planned.
steps.say: Renal screening scans the tract for every Mullerian anomaly by shared embryology.
